+
+// capturedRequest is what the provider fake received from one review.
+type capturedRequest struct {
+	path string
+	body map[string]any
+}
+
+// reviewRequest runs the command over a saved candidate that passes its initial verification
+// against a loopback fake provider, and returns the first model request the fake received.
+// The fake refuses every request, so the review ends without a verdict.
+func reviewRequest(t *testing.T, flags []string) capturedRequest {
+	t.Helper()
+	root := t.TempDir()
+	git := func(args ...string) string {
+		t.Helper()
+		c := exec.Command("git", args...)
+		c.Dir = root
+		b, e := c.CombinedOutput()
+		if e != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("git: %v %s", e, b)
+		}
+		return string(bytes.TrimSpace(b))
+	}
+	write := func(name, text string) {
+		t.Helper()
+		p := filepath.Join(root, name)
+		if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
+			t.Fatal(e)
+		}
+		if e := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(text), 0644); e != nil {
+			t.Fatal(e)
+		}
+	}
+	git("init", "-q")
+	git("config", "user.email", "test@example.invalid")
+	git("config", "user.name", "Test")
+	write(".kogen/intents/tiny/intent.md", "# Tiny\n\nSlug: tiny\nModel: not applicable — simple\nAcceptance:\n- .kogen/intents/tiny/acceptance.feature\n")
+	write(".kogen/intents/tiny/acceptance.feature", "Feature: Tiny\n")
+	write(".kogen/project.yaml", "version: 1\ncommands:\n  setup: []\n  fix: []\n  checks:\n    - name: ok\n      run: 'true'\n  acceptance:\n    run: 'echo {} > \"$KOGEN_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT\"'\n")
+	git("add", "-A")
+	git("commit", "-qm", "start")
+	start := git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
+
+	var mu sync.Mutex
+	var got []capturedRequest
+	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		b, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
+		var body map[string]any
+		_ = json.Unmarshal(b, &body)
+		mu.Lock()
+		got = append(got, capturedRequest{r.URL.Path, body})
+		mu.Unlock()
+		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
+		io.WriteString(w, `{"error":{"message":"refused by the fake","type":"invalid_request_error"}}`)
+	}))
+	defer srv.Close()
+
+	home := t.TempDir()
+	t.Setenv("HOME", home)
+	t.Setenv("KOGEN_PROVIDER_URL", srv.URL)
+	t.Setenv("KOGEN_AUTH_URL", srv.URL)
+	creds := filepath.Join(home, ".kogen", "credentials", "chatgpt.json")
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(creds), 0o700); e != nil {
+		t.Fatal(e)
+	}
+	token := fmt.Sprintf(`{"client_id":"oaiapp_fixture","access_token":"fake-access-token","refresh_token":"fake-refresh-token","expires_at":%d}`, time.Now().Unix()+3600)
+	if e := os.WriteFile(creds, []byte(token), 0o600); e != nil {
+		t.Fatal(e)
+	}
+	args := []string{"-root", root, "-start", start, "-slug", "tiny"}
+	for _, f := range flags {
+		args = append(args, strings.ReplaceAll(f, "{fake}", srv.URL))
+	}
+	var out, stderr bytes.Buffer
+	run(args, &out, &stderr)
+	var res result
+	if e := json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &res); e != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("%v: %s %s", e, out.String(), stderr.String())
+	}
+	defer os.RemoveAll(res.Run)
+	mu.Lock()
+	defer mu.Unlock()
+	if len(got) == 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("the provider fake received no request; stdout %s stderr %s", out.String(), stderr.String())
+	}
+	return got[0]
+}
+
+func TestRoleFlagsReachTheProviderRequest(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Run("every role flag supplied", func(t *testing.T) {
+		got := reviewRequest(t, []string{"-provider", "openai-compatible", "-model", "local-model", "-effort", "high", "-base-url", "{fake}/v1"})
+		// The base URL names the host, the provider selects the chat-completions route, and
+		// model and effort travel in the body unchanged.
+		if got.path != "/v1/chat/completions" || got.body["model"] != "local-model" || got.body["reasoning_effort"] != "high" {
+			t.Fatalf("request %s model %v effort %v, want /v1/chat/completions local-model high", got.path, got.body["model"], got.body["reasoning_effort"])
+		}
+	})
+	t.Run("optional role flags omitted", func(t *testing.T) {
+		got := reviewRequest(t, []string{"-model", "default-model"})
+		// The default provider chatgpt is served by the Responses route with the default medium effort.
+		reasoning, _ := got.body["reasoning"].(map[string]any)
+		if !strings.HasSuffix(got.path, "/responses") || got.body["model"] != "default-model" || reasoning["effort"] != "medium" {
+			t.Fatalf("request %s model %v reasoning %v, want a /responses request for default-model with effort medium", got.path, got.body["model"], got.body["reasoning"])
+		}
+	})
+}
